column1: # ZAP baseline (passive) rule overrides. Columns are tab separated: rule id, action (IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL), name.
# The scan is advisory (E20-N27); nothing here is a required check. Rules not listed use the ZAP default (WARN).
# Add a row only with a written reason in the PR that adds it.
# 10027 fires on every bundled JS comment in the production build and carries no signal here.

# 90004 (Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre): ignored only for the missing Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy, which would block third-party resources for no isolation benefit we use. The web app sends COOP same-origin and CORP same-origin. The marketing site does not send COOP or CORP yet, and this row hides that finding for it; revisit when marketing gets them. See docs/security/headers-and-csp.md.

# 10055 (CSP) is deliberately NOT listed, so it stays at the default WARN. The web CSP is report-only until E20-N12, so the scan sees the enforced `frame-ancestors` header only; once enforced, `img-src https:` is the wildcard it will flag and `style-src 'unsafe-inline'` may be flagged too. See docs/security/headers-and-csp.md.
